newsitem.title: USA: American Stock Exchange says committed to stocks.
newsitem.headline: American Stock Exchange says committed to stocks.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange is firmly committed to its business as a stock exchange and is not planning to spin off or discontinue its equity trading operation to focus on options, an exchange spokeswoman said.
"Absolutely not," AMEX spokeswoman Arda Nazerian said, when asked if the exchange was considering ending its stock trading business.

Questions about the AMEX's equity business were raised in an item in Monday's New York Post. The tabloid said the AMEX was mulling several options for its equity business, including spinning the operation off for absorption by the New York Stock Exchange.
In a statement responding to the Post article, AMEX Chairman Richard Syron said, "The American Stock Exchange is increasing its equity business, not exiting it."
"We are determined to continue maximizing our advantage as the only primary marketplace in the United States with a substantial presence in both equities and options," he said.
